audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributes Karma's root to her Mantra-empowered Q in five places: early ('she roots me with Mantra-Q (RQ)', 'her RQ tether'), whys[0] ('Karma roots and pokes you with Mantra-Q (RQ)'), spikes[0].text ('Mantra-empowered Q (RQ) poke and tether') and wants.foe[0] ('Mantra-Q (RQ) root-tether').
audit.why: Inner Flame slows; its Mantra bonus adds a delayed cataclysm for extra damage. There is no root on it. The root is Focused Resolve (W): 'Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy ... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again', and the Mantra bonus heals her and extends the root. This is not a naming slip — it points the player at the wrong ability, the wrong range and the wrong counterplay. Inner Flame is 950 range and unavoidable-ish poke; Focused Resolve is 675 range and is broken by moving.
audit.corrected: All five rewritten to name Focused Resolve for the root and Inner Flame for the poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere notices that Focused Resolve's cast range is shorter than Wither's.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 675 range; Wither is 700. To tether Nasus at all she must step inside the range of the one ability he has that answers her, and the entry's own advice ('bait her shield and speed, THEN W') has no trigger attached to it. The tether IS the trigger. That single fact converts the matchup's core instruction from a vague bait into a specific cue.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2] and the mid-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Gathering Fire is never mentioned, and Mantra is treated as though it were on a fixed timer.
audit.why: Gathering Fire reduces Mantra's cooldown every time one of Karma's damaging abilities lands. Mantra is 40/38/36/34 at base, but against a Nasus who stands in poke to farm it comes back far faster than that. It means chip damage is not just HP lost — it is Mantra accelerated, which is the difference between one empowered ability per wave and two. It also means dodging Inner Flame has value beyond the damage saved.
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[0] and the mid-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid-game text calls Mantra-E an 'RE dash' twice.
audit.why: Inspire is a shield plus move speed; the Mantra bonus radiates it to nearby allies. Nothing about it is a dash — she can be caught while moving, which is the whole reason Wither works on her at all. Calling it a dash implies a blink the player cannot answer.
audit.corrected: Reworded to shield and move speed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD, difficulty 7/10, on a lane Nasus wins 51.92% over 1273 games — the largest sample in this slice.
audit.why: The lane is genuinely miserable through level 5, but the matchup is not lost; the entry's own late-game text calls Nasus 'a near-unkillable splitpush threat she physically cannot 1v1'. With 1273 games behind it the win rate is about as reliable as this dataset gets.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 6/10, breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line aligned.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Skill while content win[] reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Karma/Nasus. Three stages disagree.
audit.why: The content layer explains each of the three: level 6 is 'my one even swing' because Fury of the Sands plus a Wither flips one all-in; first item is 'her threat peak' because Liandry's/Lich Bane poke plus the shield out-ranges Wither; and 2+ items is where a stacked Q deletes her. The full layer's own phases[6] text says the same thing about two items while scoring it Skill.
audit.corrected: phases[4] to Skill, phases[5] to Karma, phases[6] to Nasus.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and report[0] both call Karma 'He'; dosFull[2] says 'Wither him'.
audit.why: Karma is female and every other string in the entry uses she/her. Mixed pronouns read as copy-paste and undercut trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr, report[0].t and dosFull[2].t.

edits.before: Karma owns the entire early game, so do not pretend otherwise — I have no ult, barely any stacks, and Spirit Fire (E) is my only ranged tool, while she roots me with Mantra-Q (RQ) and pokes my fat HP bar from outside my reach. I just last-hit with Siphoning Strike (Q) and farm stacks under tower, eating the poke I cannot punish. Do not flat-out walk at her to trade — her RQ tether plus E shield mean I take three pokes for every auto I land, and Wither isn't up until level 3 anyway. Soak the lane, deny nothing, and survive.
edits.after: Karma owns the entire early game, so do not pretend otherwise — I have no ult, barely any stacks, and Spirit Fire (E) is my only ranged tool, while she roots me with Focused Resolve (W) and pokes my fat HP bar with Inner Flame (Q) from 950 range. I just last-hit with Siphoning Strike (Q) and farm stacks under tower, eating the poke I cannot punish. Do not walk at her to trade — the tether plus her Inspire (E) shield mean I take three pokes for every auto I land, and Wither isn't up until 3. Soak the lane and survive.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay hers — she's shoving with empowered Q waves or poking me down while I hoard stacks and play not to die. Wither (W) at 3 lets me peel a gank or punish a wild overstep, but I don't own any window here; her E shield and RE move speed bail her out of any half-commit I make. Level 6 is my one even swing: Fury of the Sands plus a Wither on a target who stepped up turns a single all-in in my favor, since the ult's bonus HP and per-second magic damage plus my lifesteal can grind her down if she's in melee. Bait out her E shield and RE dash, THEN W and run her down — don't burn Wither while she still has the move speed to ignore it.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay hers — she's shoving with empowered Inner Flame waves or poking me down while I hoard stacks and play not to die. Wither (W) at 3 lets me peel a gank or punish a wild overstep, but I don't own any window here; her Inspire shield and Mantra move speed bail her out of any half-commit. Worse, Gathering Fire means every ability she lands on me shortens Mantra, so eating poke costs me twice. Level 6 is my one even swing: Fury of the Sands plus a Wither on a target who stepped up turns a single all-in in my favor. Focused Resolve casts from 675 and Wither reaches 700, so the frame she tethers me is the frame I W her and run her down.

notes: I deliberately did not claim a break distance for Focused Resolve. Riot's text says the root only lands 'if the tether is not broken', and the full layer already told players to break it, but the distance at which it breaks is not in the kit file and is usually larger than the 675 cast range — so the text says breaking denies the root without promising that stepping back 675 units is enough.
